title: Classical mechanics: momentum, gravitation and contact motion
mission: Continue into uncovered scalar and one-dimensional mechanics: momentum, gravitation, contact forces, elastic response and circular motion, each with explicit frames, signs and validity. Corrections to the five admitted r1 records happen only through separate explicit correction assignments, never inside this brief. Successive batches; no chain required.
priorities: Linear momentum from mass and velocity
Newtonian gravitational force between two point masses
Kinetic (Coulomb) friction force from coefficient and normal force
Linear spring force (Hooke) from stiffness and extension
Centripetal acceleration for uniform circular motion
boundaries: Already covered, do not resubmit: translational kinetic energy, constant-acceleration displacement, velocity after constant acceleration, gravitational potential-energy difference, collinear constant-force work.
The gravitational constant enters as sourced constants metadata, never a solvable variable slot.
Friction scope is dry sliding with a supplied coefficient; spring scope is linear range with stated limits; circular-motion records stay scalar (speed and radius), with no vector formalism.
Separate speed from signed velocity, mass from weight, stiffness from strength.
Exclude relativistic dynamics, variable-force integration, multi-body simulation and general vectors.
starter_sources: https://openstax.org -- navigate to University Physics Volume 1 chapters on Linear Momentum, Gravitation, Friction and Oscillations; record exact book, edition and section, never cite the root as evidence
Find original or agency references for the gravitational constant value; starter links alone do not prove the equation
special_checks: Check the gravitational-constant value, units and power-of-ten handling against the sourced reference
Friction and spring records must state direction/sign conventions explicitly, including zero-velocity and zero-extension cases
Circular motion must guard positive radius and reject zero-radius inputs
Include negative-mass or missing-input rejection cases where applicable
integration_expectation: Momentum, stiffness and gravitation meanings are new and require extension; the scalar forms (including the integer inverse-square power) fit the engine once meanings exist. Keep exact contexts and never infer runtime readiness from matching dimensions alone.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
